title: The Delivery
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Pam nears labor and insists on waiting until midnight to go to the hospital for insurance reasons, while Michael and the office try various distractions to help her cope. Dwight objects to exploiting Pam's pregnancy for sales and proposes to Angela a business-related parenting arrangement. Eventually, Pam goes into active labor, and with Michael's chaotic assistance, she gives birth to a healthy baby girl named Cecelia Marie Halpert. The episode also explores early parenting challenges, including breastfeeding, and features budding romantic developments between Erin and Andy.

main_threads.thread: Pam's labor and delivery journey, including her insistence on timing the hospital visit, the office's distractions, the chaotic trip to the hospital, and the birth of her baby girl.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I'm having contractions, but they're irregular and far apart. So I'm not really in labor, I'm near labor.
Michael: The purpose for this meeting is to take Pam's mind off of what's going on inside of her body.
Pam: Oh, yeah, my water broke.
Michael: I got it! I got it! Everybody it's go time! At your stations.
Nurse: Daddy? She's ready to push.
Michael (smoking a cigar): Yeah, that's right. It's a baby, see?

main_threads.thread: Dwight's objections to using Pam's pregnancy for sales and his proposal to Angela regarding having a child for business reasons, including their contract discussions.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Wait a minute! You can't do that. You cannot exploit your baby for sales.
Dwight: No, no! You need to come by your sales honorably!
Dwight: I want to have a child for business reasons and I want you to be the mother.
Angela: Have you had a chance to look over the revisions on the contract I've prepared for you?
Dwight: Nothing left to do except dot the I's, the J's, and the umlauts.

main_threads.thread: Early parenting challenges faced by Jim and Pam, including breastfeeding difficulties and seeking help from a lactation consultant.

evidence.snippet: Pam: She's just, she's really tentative about latching, and I just, I want to keep her self-esteem up.
Hospital employee: Hi. I'm Clark. Josie said you might benefit from a lactation consultant.
Clark: When you're feeding, you want to press in like this, make your hand in a C.
Pam: Oh, my God. I didn't even have to do the "C thing."

main_threads.thread: Romantic developments involving Erin, Andy, and Kevin, including Michael's matchmaking attempts and Erin's acceptance of Andy's dinner invitation.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I would like you to meet your new boyfriend.
Erin: I'm so sorry if I gave you the impression I'm into Kevin, but I'm not. I like Andy.
Erin: I want to continue working on our friendship.
Andy: Erin, uh, I need you to send this fax immediately.
Andy: The fax says "Erin, will you have dinner with me?"
Erin: Oh, my God. That's amazing.
